- [USER] User asked, "Why did the Haitian Revolution begin?"
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Haitian Revolution was a slave revolt that took place in the French colony of Saint-Domingue (present-day Haiti) between 1791 and 1804.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It was the largest and most successful slave revolt in modern history, resulting in the establishment of Haiti as the first independent black nation in the world.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Haitian Revolution began as a conflict between enslaved Africans and their French colonial masters.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Enslaved Africans in Saint-Domingue had long been subjected to brutal treatment, including harsh working conditions, physical abuse, and a lack of legal rights.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A series of political and economic events in France and the French colonies sparked a series of uprisings among the enslaved population in Saint-Domingue.
